Another level for vegetarian food
May 2025 • Family
This vegetarian restaurant truly takes plant-based cuisine to another level. The presentation and flavors are outstanding — you might forget you’re even eating vegetarian! Dishes that resemble sushi, sashimi, snail, and fish salad are crafted with such precision and creativity that they’ll leave you saying wow with every bite.

The ambiance is serene and peaceful, with a quiet, almost Buddhist vibe that makes the dining experience feel like a retreat for the soul.

While the prices are a bit higher than your typical vegetarian spot, the quality, taste, and artistry make it absolutely worth it. A must-visit if you’re looking to elevate your vegetarian dining experience!
